title: Bio Ionic 10X Styling Iron Hair Straightener

comparisons.notes: Bio Ionic 10X 1-inch Pro Hair Styling Iron, current version with Memory Function and 60-second ramp-up. Page opened, in stock.
Brand's own page for the new 10X Styler (1-inch, 450F, 50W, Memory Function, 9 ft cord). Page opened, $262 with no sale.
Black (New) variant sold by the brand's reseller and fulfilled by Walmart, Add to cart shown on Walmart's indexed product page.

writeup: The Bio Ionic 10X 1-inch styling iron with sonic vibrating plates and Memory Mode is $87.99 at Woot. Ulta, Walmart and Bio Ionic's own store all charge $262 for the same model, so this is about 66% less. Woot shows only 3 left with a limit of 3 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: ASIN B0FCNVV3XG is the Black 1-inch 10X, model Z-10XFI-1.0-AZ, UPC 736658450385, matching the Woot listing's ASIN.
